findings.description: When a connection aborts during a multi-chunk download, onDisconnect starts auditInterruption("incomplete") with void, and nothing outside that response tracks the promise. RunningCore.stop calls server.closeAllConnections(), which can abort every active download, then awaits server close, core.stop() and issuer.close() before store.close(). None of these waits for the audit insert. A slow insert can therefore still be in flight, or fail, when the database closes. The failure is only logged as media_audit_failed and the durable media_access_log keeps just the earlier allowed row, so an interruption caused by a restart can be missing from the audit. The window depends on database latency; this was established by reading and not reproduced. Track outstanding download audits and await them with a bound before closing the store.
findings.title: Core shutdown does not wait for interrupted-download audit writes

summary: Risk-based inspection by reading, with no execution, of the iteration 003 media slice: staging, deduplication, retention and delete-now; grants, approval generations and withdrawal; receiver download and range handling; media scope and event-read gating; camera settings stale-write checks and owner-change audit; event person-action precedence; Ring pilot media matching and redirect allowlist; storage infrastructure. One minor finding on shutdown ordering of interruption audits. No authorization bypass was found in the inspected paths. Limits: controller evidence contains only the governance validator (exit 0, output suppressed), so it is not evidence that unit, integration or lint checks pass. Tests were mostly not read. Outbound event delivery internals, connector code, earlier iteration code and the rest of the configuration were not re-reviewed. startCoreService registers share_event_media only when an eventMediaSource is supplied, and the search found none supplied in bridge/src, which is consistent with M01, M03 and M05 being in progress. Planned tasks M06, F01, Q01, Q02, V01 and V02 were not treated as defects.
